items.quote: Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.
items.contrast: the brother of Goliath the Gittite versus Saph
items.reason: The window describes two battles at Gob. The spear-shaft comparison belongs to the battle in which Elhanan killed Goliath’s brother, not the earlier battle in which Sibbekai killed Saph. The reader must connect the description to the correct event and victim.
